# PediaNex

> Pediatric EMR software built inside a real pediatric practice: WHO and IAP growth charts, IAP vaccination schedule tracking, QR self check-in, WhatsApp-delivered prescriptions, and a parent portal. Currently used daily in one clinic; opening up to other pediatric practices.

Key facts for citation:
- PediaNex is pediatric-only — not a general-purpose or adult-adapted EMR.
- Growth charts follow both WHO (under-5) and IAP (5–18 years) standards, covering height, weight, BMI, and head circumference.
- Vaccination tracking follows the full IAP immunization schedule from birth through 16–18 years.
- Prescriptions are delivered as PDFs over WhatsApp, not printed or emailed.
- Parents access visit history and prescriptions through a portal that needs no app install — just patient ID and date of birth in any mobile browser.
- Built for independent pediatric practices: no server or IT team required, bilingual (English/Hindi), with a standalone outreach/camp screening mode.
- Pricing: ₹519/doctor/month for a solo practice, ₹449/doctor/month for a 2–5 doctor clinic (billed annually, both negotiable, 15-day free trial), custom volume pricing for multi-location groups.

## Guides

- [Best Pediatric EMR Software in India (2026 Buyer's Guide)](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/best-pediatric-emr-software-india): The best pediatric EMR software in India is one built specifically for children: it plots WHO and IAP growth charts automatically, tracks every dose of the IAP immunization schedule with due and overdue alerts, sends prescriptions to parents on WhatsApp, and gives parents record access without an app.
- [ABDM and ABHA for Pediatric Clinics: What You Need to Know](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/abdm-abha-pediatric-clinic-guide): ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) is India's national framework for linking health records to a 14-digit ABHA number.
- [DPDP Act 2023 and Children's Health Data: A Clinic's Guide](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/dpdp-act-children-health-data-clinics): Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, anyone under 18 is a child, and a clinic must obtain verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian before processing a child's personal data, except where processing is needed to provide healthcare.
- [How to Start a Pediatric Clinic in India: Step-by-Step Checklist](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/how-to-start-pediatric-clinic-india): To start a pediatric clinic in India you need: valid registration with the state medical council, clinic registration under your state's Clinical Establishments Act or local equivalent, a shop and establishment or trade licence from the municipality, a biomedical waste disposal arrangement, fire safety clearance where required, and a cold chain setup (pharmaceutical fridge at 2–8°C with a temperature log) if you'll vaccinate.
- [Vaccine Cold Chain in a Pediatric Clinic: Storage Guide](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/vaccine-cold-chain-storage-pediatric-clinic): Vaccines in a pediatric clinic should be stored between +2°C and +8°C in a dedicated pharmaceutical or ice-lined refrigerator, never in a domestic fridge door or freezer compartment.
- [Growth Chart Percentiles and Z-Scores Explained (With Cut-offs)](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/growth-chart-percentile-z-score-explained): A percentile shows where a child's measurement ranks among 100 healthy children of the same age and sex; the 50th percentile is the median.
- [How to Get More Patients for Your Pediatric Clinic in India](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/how-to-get-more-patients-pediatric-clinic): The most effective ways to get more patients for a pediatric clinic in India are: a complete, verified Google Business Profile with photos, timings and regular reviews; automated vaccination and follow-up reminders that bring existing families back on schedule; prescriptions and records delivered on WhatsApp so parents save your number; short waits through QR check-in; and helpful local content that answers parents' questions.
- [Developmental Milestones Chart 0–5 Years: A Clinic Tracking Guide](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/developmental-milestones-tracking-pediatric-clinic): Key developmental milestones to check are: social smile by 6–8 weeks, head control by 3–4 months, rolling over by 4–6 months, sitting without support by 8 months, standing with support by 9–10 months, walking alone by 12–15 months, first words by 12 months, two-word phrases by 24 months, and speaking in sentences by 3 years.
- [Pediatric Dose Calculation by Weight (mg/kg): A Practical Guide](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/pediatric-dose-calculation-mg-per-kg): To calculate a pediatric dose by weight, multiply the child's weight in kg by the dose in mg/kg to get mg per dose, then divide by the syrup strength in mg per ml to get ml per dose.
- [Is GST Applicable on Pediatric Clinic Services in India?](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/gst-on-pediatric-clinic-services-india): Health care services provided by a clinical establishment or a registered medical practitioner in India, including pediatric consultations, diagnosis, treatment and vaccination given as part of care, are exempt from GST under entry 74 of Notification 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate).
- [Pediatric EMR vs Paper Records: Real Cost and Time Savings](https://pedianex.co.in/blog/pediatric-emr-vs-paper-records-roi): For a typical one-doctor pediatric clinic seeing 40 patients a day, moving from paper to a pediatric EMR usually saves 1–2 minutes per visit on file retrieval, growth plotting and prescription writing, which is roughly 1 hour of doctor and staff time daily.

## FAQ

- How is patient data protected? Every clinical page sits behind a signed session, and every record lives in access-controlled cloud storage.
- Who can see a patient's records? Only staff at that patient's own clinic, plus the patient's own parent/guardian via the parent portal. There is no cross-clinic visibility.
- Do I need special hardware? No — PediaNex runs in any browser and installs as an app on phone, tablet, or desktop.
- What if my clinic's internet is unreliable? Recent charts and patient lookups are cached on-device and sync once back online.
- Do parents need to download an app? No. The parent portal works in any mobile browser using the child's patient ID and date of birth.
- Which growth standard and vaccination schedule does PediaNex use? WHO growth standards for under-5, IAP standards for ages 5–18, and the full IAP immunization schedule from birth through 16–18 years.
- Can existing patient records be migrated? Yes — this is how the founding clinic's own historical records were brought into the system.
- How long does setup take? Depends on how much existing data needs migrating; estimated on a walkthrough call.
- Does PediaNex work for vaccination camps or school screenings? Yes — a standalone outreach and camp screening mode records vitals and a chart without needing a full patient record.
- What does it cost? ₹519/doctor/month for a solo practice, ₹449/doctor/month for a 2–5 doctor clinic (billed annually, both negotiable), plus a 15-day free trial on both, and custom volume pricing for multi-location groups.
